verdict.rationale: Adyen's Dynamic 3D Secure lets merchants set rules that decide which card payments go through 3DS authentication and whether they are challenged. That covers the core of triggering 3DS when risky. The evidence never mentions SCA exemption requests (for example TRA or low-value exemptions) or automatic handling of European PSD2 requirements, so the compliance-plus-exemption half of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented SCA exemption requesting, EU/PSD2 mandate-aware routing, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, European traffic is routed intelligently through SCA — 3DS triggered when required or risky, exemptions requested when safe — to protect both compliance and conversion

citations.quote: Set up rules to determine which card payments are routed through 3D Secure authentication, and if they should be challenged.
